contrast.how_measured: Built page (production build, 1440x900, client-picked all-accounts Holdings tab, synthetic fixture), hygiene-driver.mjs: for each of 72 visible text nodes' parent elements (opacity under 0.05 skipped), computed color composited with element opacity against the effective background (computed background-color composited down the ancestors to the first opaque one); WCAG 2.1 relative luminance ratio. Under that computed-style-only method 27 texts read under 3:1 (26 inside the Total Assets hero: #C5B9FD, #FFFFFF and #F4F6FA against #F4F6FA; 1 an opacity-0 sidebar label), the same shape and size as the walk's 32-36. That is an artefact: the hero paints a navy gradient through background-image with a transparent background-color, so the computed backdrop falls through to the canvas. Re-measured with the backdrop SAMPLED (all text made transparent, full-page screenshot, pixels read under each gradient-backed text's own range rectangle, worse of lightest and darkest pixel kept): 72 texts, 0 under 3:1, 0 under 4.5:1, lowest 4.82 (#111827 on #3B82F6). So failing_before 0 by the sampled method (27 by the computed-style-only method, kept here as the walk-like reading). No texts sit on the light canvas or a white panel under 3:1, so no ink-token edit was made; failing_after equals failing_before. NOT measured: one-account and no-client states, hover previews, dialogs. That the walker erred the same way is inferred (row DSGN_IRPTV1-D2-W62-S4).

bands.per_design_law: portal/DESIGN.md C3 row: 'band | palette.darkField | #0A1733 | ONE deliberate full-bleed band per page, never the default container'; and: 'Navy #163372 is text and hairline only, never a container fill. A dark card sitting on the light canvas, a panel inside a panel inside a panel, or a second band on one page violates this clause.' portal/CLAUDE.md Known divergence: 'PanelHeader, DarkCard and NestedCard are band-valued too ... A page can therefore render several bands where C3 allows one. C3 is the law and such a page is the defect.'
